title: Episode spec
description: One episode as data: everything a Blender (bpy) renderer needs to build and animate every shot. Frame numbers are ABSOLUTE film frames at `fps`. Yacht-local axes: +z bow, +x starboard, y up, metres (three.js / glTF convention, Y-up). Storage paths are keys relative to the storage root (local FS in dev, R2 in cloud). Keyframe lists ([[f, v], ...]) interpolate linearly between keys and hold the first/last value outside them; a step is written as two keys on consecutive frames.

source.description: Provenance (extension): exporter name, source files, export time.

wordsJson.description: Word timings [{w, s, e}] in seconds from the start of the narration file.

mix.description: Optional final mix (music + sfx + narration). If present it replaces narration in the final encode.

offsetFrames.description: Extension: film frame at which the narration file starts (word at t s lands on frame offsetFrames + round(t*fps)). Default 0.

moonDir.description: Direction TO the moon (not normalised). Also sets the glitter path.

characters.description: name -> rigged character GLB (e.g. hero -> assets/characters/hero/hero.glb).

motions.description: clip name -> assets/motions/<name>.glb (hero mesh + one action 'retarget_clip', 30 fps).

storageKey.description: Storage-root-relative key, no leading slash, no '..'.

scalarKeys.description: [[frame, value], ...] sorted by frame. Linear between keys, hold outside.

asset.description: Key in assets.props (preferred, e.g. 'island') or a storage key ending .glb.

z.description: World metres (+z = south in the OSM data).

scale.description: Uniform scale applied to the (scale 1, true-size) island GLB.

fov.description: VERTICAL field of view, degrees (three.js PerspectiveCamera). Interpolated in log space.

ease.description: Ease used for the segment ARRIVING at this key (default 'move'). Bezier: arrive(.16,1,.3,1) move(.65,0,.35,1) exit(.7,0,.84,0) anticipate(.5,-.32,.25,1) overshoot(.34,1.45,.64,1); crashIn = t^3.

px.description: Peak amplitude in screen px at 1080 wide.

tau.description: Decay constant in frames: amp = px*exp(-t/tau), active for 6*tau frames.

space.description: world: cam/look are world metres. yacht: cam/look are yacht-local metres; cam position follows the yacht's x/z/heading and 0.6 x its heave but NOT its pitch/roll (a human operator); look follows the full yacht matrix (buoyancy pitch/roll included).

handheld.description: Handheld amplitude (degrees-ish): jx = h*(sin(f*.31)+.6 sin(f*.83+1.7)), jy = h*(sin(f*.47+.9)+.5 sin(f*1.13+3.1)), applied to look at ~1deg/m-at-distance. Number or [[f,v]] keys. Default 0.2.

drift.description: Extension: slow positional drift amplitude in metres so holds never freeze (default 0.25).

heading.description: Radians about world +y; heading pi/2 points the bow along world +x.

lights.description: 0..1 multiplier on cabin glow, cabin point light and nav lights (the GLB stores the lights-on = 1 values).

hatch.description: 0..1 foredeck hatch open (node hatch_pivot, rotation.x = -hatch*1.9 rad).

pitch.description: Radians added to buoyancy pitch (bow up positive).

sink.description: Metres the hull sits lower than its buoyant height (aground / flooding).

from.description: Absolute film frame at which the clip's frame 0 plays. Later tracks blend over earlier ones.

fade.description: Crossfade-in frames over the tracks below.

offset.description: Extension: start offset into the clip, frames.

rotY.description: Radians about yacht +y; 0 faces the bow (+z), pi/2 faces starboard (+x).

height.description: Extension: world height in metres the character is scaled to (default 1.8).

lookAt.description: Head aim target: the camera, or a yacht-local point.

lookWeight.description: Extension: 0..1 head-aim weight (default 0.8 when lookAt is set).

fireKeys.description: [[frame, [v0..v5]], ...]: per-fire intensity 0..1 for the island's six fires (nodes fire_0..fire_5 / fire_light_0..5). Linear between keys.

scene.description: Extension: scene name from the cue table.

keyFrame.description: Extension: the representative frame for storyboards / QC stills.

island.description: Extension: per-shot override of world.island (null hides it).

env.description: Extension: per-shot overrides of world.moonDir / seaState / dawn.
